judge.rationale: The candidate only completed the planning/test-writing phase and failed to actually modify `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts`, so the bug remains unfixed and its own new acceptance test will fail. Additionally, the new test in `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.acceptance.test.ts` contains a bug where `callerRejection` is captured from `.catch()`, left unused (which will fail eslint), and `callerRejection: rejection` is pushed into `observed` instead, making the caller-rejection check tautological. The candidate also missed updating `CHANGELOG.md` as required by the acceptance criteria and left behind an internal `.lore/dod.md` artifact. It did, however, update `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md` with the new guarantee.
